Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Nitin - 35 years, son
Look: glasses, brown sweater
2. Anjali - 59 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Karan - 59 years, father
Look: moustache, checked shirt
4. Meenakshi - 29 years, daughter
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
5. Manoj - 28 years, friend
Look: moustache, checked shirt

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Nitin stands in the living room. Karan and Meenakshi stand near him.]

Nitin: "Today feels like a good day."

[Nitin laughs out loud at the comedy film.]

Nitin: "What happened?"

[Nitin jumps in his seat at the scary scene.]

Nitin: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
